text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Mejiro Bright and I visit the shrine to pray for her condition to improve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Phew… Thank you for coming along today.
choice_data_list: Right, let's go purify our hands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Just a moment… We ought to calm our spirits beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We'll soon be in the presence of the divine, so our minds must be pure as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now, hold the ladle in your right hand and wash your left hand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Next, take the ladle in your cleansed left hand…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now that our minds and bodies are pristine, let's make our way through the torii gate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our very traditional shrine visit continues exactly in line with the proper etiquette…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That concludes our shrine visit. Thank you once again for accompanying me.
choice_data_list: That shrine visit was very… proper.
That shrine visit was very… proper.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But of course! Given my condition of late, I wish to do everything I possibly can to hasten my recovery.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I shall soar to great heights someday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But simply reaching those heights won't do. I must be elegant, magnificent, and dignified every step of the way as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, that is my aspiration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Being in slightly worse-than-usual condition is no excuse for slovenly behavior in public.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That makes sense. And it's just the kind of logic I've come to expect from Mejiro Bright. In which case, I want nothing more than to help her reach those heights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hippity-hop, hippity-hop, hippity-hop. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Have you noticed? ♪ The cloud that was hanging over me has lifted!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I absolutely must extend my gratitude. Trainer, would you join me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's feeling better again. I have to show how thankful I am too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright suddenly loses her balance and stumbles a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I sincerely apologize… I suddenly felt rather lightheaded there…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like she was standing for so long that she lost her balance.
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day and go home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes… I suppose these things do take time after all.
